# Security

ServerInator runs as root on the phone, and the VPS holds a key that is
root on the phone. If you find a way around that model (see "Security
model" in the README), please report it privately: open a draft advisory at
https://github.com/nmorozov539-wq/Serverinator/security/advisories/new
rather than a public issue. Fixes go into the latest release only.
